_note: MCP server configuration for AI-assisted Flutter development. The MCP ecosystem is evolving — treat these integrations as experimental. Server package names and APIs may change. Verify current package names before use.

filesystem.description: Gives AI read access to the project's actual file structure. Useful for understanding what's really there vs. what ARCHITECTURE.md says.
filesystem._setup: No auth needed. Replace ${workspaceFolder} with an absolute path if needed.

github.description: Lets AI read issues, PRs, and repo metadata from GitHub. Useful for understanding requirements and tracking what's in flight.
github._setup: Create a GitHub personal access token with repo read permissions. Set GITHUB_TOKEN in your environment — do not hardcode it here.

supabase.description: Lets AI inspect your Supabase schema, query tables, and check RLS policies. Replace with Firebase if you're using Firestore.
supabase._setup: Replace YOUR_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF with your actual project ref. Set SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN in environment.
supabase._note: Supabase MCP is experimental. Verify current package name at https://github.com/supabase/mcp-server-supabase before using.

_integrations_not_yet_available.dart_analyzer: No production-ready MCP server for Dart analysis tooling yet. Would be useful for type-aware code generation.
_integrations_not_yet_available.pub_dev: No MCP server for pub.dev package search. Manually check https://pub.dev for current package versions.
_integrations_not_yet_available.firebase: Firebase does not have a stable MCP server. Track: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers

_security_notes: Never hardcode credentials or API keys in this file
The filesystem server exposes your project directory — review what it can access
For team projects, keep this file as an example template; each developer configures their own credentials
Consider keeping mcp.json in .gitignore if your project has sensitive local files
